persona: fresh CODING AGENT — consumes ONLY AGENTS.md (repo root), docs/developer/machine/**, the public API wire surface, and the SDK where the machine artifacts point (no human docs, no console, no src/ contract reading)

substrate.composition: REAL createApiServer over REAL module services (executions/credentials/quotas/sandbox-identities/economics, in-memory stores) + REAL runtime deployment identity (manifest digest + provider-tiers ledger + git revision); worker-path settler drives governed transitions + settlement ledger event (costMicroUsd 4125, usage {inputTokens 2100, outputTokens 340}, one artifact with digest) — the platform-side completion a bound worker + provider rail performs on a hosted plane; live provider completion honest NOT RUN
substrate.connectionValues: the operator-provided bootstrap credential (the recipe's prerequisites) + the persona's OWN credential issued through the public POST /credentials route

legs.title: agent discovery (AGENTS.md entry → the machine manifests)
machine-contract reading (openapi / capability / env-vars / error-codes / examples / recipe)
authenticate (operator values → the public credential route)
executions across the capability portfolio (wire drive + literal examples)
validation library list + rerun (the machine-contract view)
export path (the reproducibility bundle, machine-contract view)
honest boundaries (the not-run registry of the trial)

steps.action: read AGENTS.md at the repository root (the coding-agent entry point); look for the machine-contract surface
steps.expectation: AGENTS.md leads an integrating agent to docs/developer/machine/** (the machine manifests)
steps.observed: AGENTS.md is the INTERNAL program contract (architect/Tech Lead/implementer recovery sequence: AI_CONTINUATION.md, LLM-* handoffs, spec/*) and carries NO reference to docs/developer/machine/** — a fresh integrating agent's discovery dead-ends at the root; the persona reaches the machine manifests only by repository directory exploration

steps.action: open the machine-contract surface: 6 manifests under docs/developer/machine/ (found by directory exploration)
steps.expectation: every manifest exists and parses as JSON with schemaVersion 1
steps.observed: all 6 machine manifests parse (schemaVersion 1)

steps.action: resolve every path the manifest web references (example files, family examples, recipe artifacts)
steps.expectation: every referenced file exists in the repository
steps.observed: every manifest-referenced path resolves

steps.action: read openapi.json — the ONE canonical wire contract (paths, security scheme, header parameters)
steps.expectation: the route table, bearerAuth scheme and the x-zeck-application / idempotency-key header contracts are declared
steps.observed: openapi.json declares 27 paths / 28 route entries, bearerAuth security, the required x-zeck-application scoped-read header and the mandatory POST idempotency-key

steps.action: read error-codes.json — the canonical error taxonomy and its deterministic status mapping
steps.expectation: the taxonomy covers the public error vocabulary with deterministic statuses (401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED never-retry, 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, …)
steps.observed: error-codes.json declares 17 codes with deterministic statuses; the persona's wire-parity probes (401/409/422/404) will verify the mapping for real

steps.action: read env-vars.json — the three required connection values + the optional selector; probe the CLI's documented default URL against the machine
steps.expectation: the three required variables are declared; the persona knows where the values come from (the target deployment's operator)
steps.observed: ZECK_API_URL / ZECK_TOKEN / ZECK_APPLICATION_ID required, ZECK_ENVIRONMENT_ID optional; CLI-default claim present — probe: a NON-Zeck service answers on 127.0.0.1:3000 in this environment (GET /identity returns a non-Zeck document) — the CLI default targets no Zeck composition here; environment-specific observation, recorded not interpreted as a platform claim

steps.action: read capability-manifest.json — the seeded capabilities, the 22 workload families and the honest availability classification
steps.expectation: 22 families with the runnable/provider-gated split and named gates
steps.observed: capability-manifest declares 22 families — 11 runnable / 11 provider-gated (gates: QWEN_API_KEY, (rail boundary), OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ZECK_3D_API_KEY)

steps.action: read examples-manifest.json and reconcile it with the capability manifest's family classifications
steps.expectation: 27 examples; every family's canonical example carries the same classification in both manifests
steps.observed: 27 examples reconcile with the 22 families (classification parity holds; 16 runnable / 11 provider-gated)

steps.action: read integration-recipe.json — the deterministic agent integration recipe
steps.expectation: the 9 steps are sequential and the prerequisites name the three connection values
steps.observed: integration-recipe carries 9 sequential steps; prerequisites: Bun, the repository, and ZECK_API_URL / ZECK_TOKEN / ZECK_APPLICATION_ID from the target deployment's operator

steps.action: obtain the three connection values from the target deployment's operator (recipe step 3; environment only — never flags, never files)
steps.expectation: ZECK_API_URL, ZECK_TOKEN and ZECK_APPLICATION_ID are set from operator-provided material
steps.observed: connection identity present: api=http://127.0.0.1:4078, application=00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000142, token=<operator bootstrap credential, 69 chars, never logged>

steps.action: verify the failure semantics first: GET /agents with a wrong bearer credential
steps.expectation: 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, retryable=false — the error-codes.json deterministic mapping, verified on the wire
steps.observed: HTTP 401 {code AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, retryable false, message 'invalid credential'} — the taxonomy mapping holds on the wire

steps.action: issue the persona's OWN credential through the public route: POST /credentials {applicationId, label, role} + Idempotency-Key (the openapi contract)
steps.expectation: 201 with the show-once secret present and replayed=false (the credential metadata never carries the secret again)
steps.observed: HTTP 201 — credential 00000000-0000-7000-c000-000000000001 issued (status active); show-once secret captured (69 chars, value never logged)

steps.action: verify the issued credential: GET /agents with the persona secret + X-Zeck-Application
steps.expectation: HTTP 200 (an empty inventory is the documented normal state for a fresh application)
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — 0 agent(s) (the agents authority projects the inventory; empty is normal)

steps.action: replay the SAME issue request (same idempotency key, same body): the show-once contract
steps.expectation: replayed=true with secret=null — the durable outcome replays, the secret never crosses twice
steps.observed: HTTP 201 replayed=true, secret=null — the show-once discipline holds

steps.action: probe the collision discipline: same idempotency key with a DIFFERENT request body
steps.expectation: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED — the deterministic mapping the taxonomy documents, verified on the wire
steps.observed: HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (a client bug surfaced as designed, never retried)

steps.action: drive the credential lifecycle: rotate then revoke, each request built from the route's DECLARED openapi parameters (the persona never guesses undocumented headers)
steps.expectation: the openapi-documented rotate/revoke routes behave exactly as documented
steps.observed: rotate → 200 (new secret issued, 69 chars); old secret → 401; new secret → 200; revoke → 200; revoked secret → 401 — the full lifecycle holds

steps.action: search the machine contract (openapi paths, examples-manifest, recipe) for the application-creation surface
steps.expectation: an application-create path exists OR the boundary is documented machine-side
steps.observed: the openapi route table carries NO application-lifecycle route (the frozen create contract carries the per-request applicationId selector only) — the machine boundary manifest documents the application authority's out-of-band provisioning path as THE path

steps.action: adopt the operator-provided application scope (ZECK_APPLICATION_ID — the scope the membership rows authorize)
steps.expectation: the scoped reads and governed commands accept the application scope
steps.observed: application scope 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000142 adopted; every scoped call carries X-Zeck-Application per the openapi parameter contract

steps.action: read the sandbox quota envelope: GET /sandbox/quotas with the application scope
steps.expectation: the configured dimensions render with the honest telemetry boundary
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — 1 dimension row(s) (sandbox-concurrency=5); telemetry.realtime=false (the honest boundary)

steps.action: read the synthetic-data policy artifact: GET /sandbox/data-policy
steps.expectation: the versioned, digest-carrying governed document serves verbatim
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — version 1, digest sha256:368368f43c78c18a… (the governed artifact, never a local copy)

steps.action: probe the sandbox-identity read with an unknown id (the scope-checked miss semantics)
steps.expectation: HTTP 404 — indistinguishable-from-missing, exactly as the openapi documents the route's 404
steps.observed: HTTP 404 {code AUTHORIZATION_DENIED} — the honest miss (recorded: this route's 404 body carries AUTHORIZATION_DENIED while the executions routes' scope-checked misses carry CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE — both are documented 404 shapes; the openapi pins neither body code for this route, so no contract violation is claimed)

steps.action: create an execution through the wire contract: POST /executions {applicationId, task, constraints} + Idempotency-Key
steps.expectation: 201 with the execution receipt (executionId, status, replayed=false)
steps.observed: HTTP 201 — execution 00000000-0000-7000-9000-000000000002 (status CREATED, replayed=false)

steps.action: poll GET /executions/<id> to a terminal status (the documented lifecycle pattern — the wire exposes no push channel)
steps.expectation: the execution reaches COMPLETED with a settled ledger
steps.observed: terminal status COMPLETED; the ledger carries 8 event(s)

steps.action: replay the SAME create (same key + same fingerprint)
steps.expectation: the durable outcome replays: replayed=true, same executionId
steps.observed: HTTP 201 replayed=true — the durable outcome, not a second execution

steps.action: execute every runnable examples-manifest entry LITERALLY: bun run <manifest path> with the manifest-declared env vars (15 entries; the webhook receiver follows separately)
steps.expectation: every runnable example completes as written (exit 0) with zero hidden assumptions
steps.observed: literal-execution failures: examples/economic-actions.ts: exit 1 — stderr/stdout tail: essage":"economic action draft rejected: purpose: purpose must be one of purchase, payment, transfer, refund, charge, machine-resource; recipient.kind: recipient.kind is outside the closed vocabulary","retryable":false} |

steps.action: root-cause the failed create through the machine contract: read openapi.json's EconomicActionRequest schema for the fields the wire's rejection enforced
steps.expectation: every closed-vocabulary field the economics authority enforces carries its enum in the openapi schema (the machine agent can learn the vocabulary from the manifest)
steps.observed: the closed vocabularies are documented: purpose ∈ {purchase|payment|transfer|refund|charge|machine-resource}; recipient.kind ∈ {seller|merchant|provider|wallet|account}; currency ∈ {usd|eur|gbp|jpy|cad|aud|chf}; requiredCapabilities[].kind ∈ {model|tool|algorithm|data|runtime|human}

steps.action: run the webhook-receiver example as its manifest row + header document it (ZECK_WEBHOOK_SECRET + ZECK_WEBHOOK_PORT, the receiver listening on /webhooks/zeck): deliver an UNSIGNED event, a VALIDLY-SIGNED event, then a redelivery
steps.expectation: unsigned → 401 (never trusted); valid signature → 202 applied; redelivery → 202 replay-acknowledged without re-application
steps.observed: receiver booted (its own documented run line printed); unsigned → 401 'invalid signature'; signed → 202 'applied (eventId …)'; redelivery → 202 'replay acknowledged' — verify-before-trusting + exactly-once both hold

steps.action: execute every provider-gated examples-manifest entry as written (core env only — the provider credential NAMES are explicitly absent): 11 entries
steps.expectation: each prints its recorded availability boundary and completes its code path; provider COMPLETION stays honest NOT RUN
steps.observed: 11/11 provider-gated examples ran their code path with the gated banner printed (the named contracts: QWEN_API_KEY, (rail boundary), OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ZECK_3D_API_KEY); live provider completion is the recorded NOT RUN boundary

steps.action: retrieve the result package: GET /executions/<id>/results
steps.expectation: the honest end-state: COMPLETED, settled integer-micro-USD cost, rail-reported usage, artifact digests, verification rows
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — status COMPLETED, cost 4125 micro-USD (usd), usage 2100/340 tokens, 1 artifact(s) (digest sha256:dep042-000002), 1 verification row(s), 0 warning(s)

steps.action: retrieve the evidence trail: GET /executions/<id>/events
steps.expectation: the ordered, gapless event ledger (lifecycle visibility)
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — 8 event(s), sequences 1..8 gapless (execution.created → execution.authorize → execution.plan → execution.queue → execution.start → execution.verify…)

steps.action: retrieve the verification axis: GET /executions/<id>/verification
steps.expectation: the evidence verdicts with criterion/strategy/status
steps.observed: HTTP 200 — 1 row(s): cites-sources = PASS (strategy rubric)

steps.action: probe the lifecycle-command boundary: POST /executions/<id>/cancel on the COMPLETED execution
steps.expectation: 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION — the deterministic mapping the taxonomy documents (only non-terminal executions accept cancel)
steps.observed: HTTP 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION — the state machine's refusal is exact

steps.action: search the machine contract for the Validation Library surface (openapi routes, examples-manifest entries, integration-recipe steps)
steps.expectation: a machine-readable list/rerun path exists OR the boundary is declared machine-side
steps.observed: no validation-library route/example exists in the machine contract (openapi: 0 /validation routes; examples-manifest: 0 entries) — the machine boundary manifest surface-boundaries.json declares it a console-plane surface (honest unavailable, recorded) and the integration-recipe's invariant points the agent at the declaration

steps.action: the validation-library list + rerun leg
steps.expectation: the leg completes OR its boundary is recorded with an owner
steps.observed: NOT RUN — the Validation Library rerun is a console-plane surface in this base (no machine route); the persona records the honest boundary. Owner: Lead (either expose a machine-readable library list/rerun route set or keep the boundary declared machine-side)

steps.action: search the machine contract for the execution reproducibility-bundle export surface (openapi routes, examples-manifest entries)
steps.expectation: a machine-readable export path exists OR the boundary is declared machine-side
steps.observed: no export route/example exists in the machine contract — the machine boundary manifest declares the reproducibility bundle a console-plane surface (honest unavailable, recorded)

steps.action: the export-path leg (retrieving the reproducibility bundle through the machine surface)
steps.expectation: the leg completes OR its boundary is recorded with an owner
steps.observed: NOT RUN — the reproducibility-bundle export is a console-plane surface in this base (no machine route); the persona records the honest boundary. Owner: Lead (expose a machine export route or keep the boundary declared machine-side)

steps.action: compile the provider-gated families' named contracts from the capability manifest
steps.expectation: every gated family names its gate (credential env var NAME or rail boundary)
steps.observed: 11 provider-gated families → QWEN_API_KEY (3: voice, image-generation, video-media); (rail boundary — no authorized rail) (3: realtime-voice, browser-use, computer-use); OPENROUTER_API_KEY (3: image-recognition, vlm, multimodal); OPENAI_API_KEY (1: audio-understanding); ZECK_3D_API_KEY (1: three-d)

steps.action: the live-provider completion rails (real model/tool/media completions through OPENROUTER_API_KEY / QWEN_API_KEY / …)
steps.expectation: the boundary is recorded honestly — never a fabricated provider result
steps.observed: NOT RUN — no operator provider credentials exist in this environment; every execution settled through the platform's own governed transition commands with the settlement envelope recorded in the ledger (the worker-path seam). Zero live provider cost consumed. Owner: Lead credentialed re-run (the hosted-plane trial with authorized rails)

steps.action: the public-internet variant of the journey against a hosted deployment
steps.expectation: the boundary is recorded honestly
steps.observed: NOT RUN — no public hosted Zeck URL exists in this environment; the trial ran against a REAL locally-booted plane serving the same public contract (real processes, real HTTP). Owner: Lead credentialed re-run (deploy a preview plane per PUBLIC-DEPLOYMENT.md §3.2 and re-drive the journey)

findingsSurfaced.title: AGENTS.md (the repository-root agent entry point) does not reference the machine-contract surface — a fresh coding agent cannot discover docs/developer/machine/** from the canonical entry
findingsSurfaced.reproduction: read AGENTS.md top to bottom; grep -n 'docs/developer\|machine/' AGENTS.md → no matches (its recovery sequence targets internal program agents: AI_CONTINUATION.md, docs/LLM-*, spec/*); README.md equally carries no developer-kit entry (the DEP-041 F1 merge note, still open); the persona finds docs/developer/machine/ only by directory exploration
